name: Delaware County, PA
findings: Delaware County has 2,121 nonprofit organizations. 938 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 773 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Delaware County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 170 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 170 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for civic or political action
